notes: Breadboard bank mapping: the image's upper area (rows f-j) is treated as bank 'b' and the lower area (rows a-e) as bank 't', per the catalogue naming.

Breadboard holes were estimated from the picture: resistor 3b.g to 6b.g, LED anode (bent, longer leg) 6b.h and cathode 8b.h, pot pins 22t.e / 23b.f / 24t.e. Wire ends are on the same strips as the component legs.
The parts list gives 6 jumper wires, but the image shows only 5, so 5 are modelled.
The usb-cable has no ports, so it is linked to the Arduino with a port-less joined edge. It powers the board and carries serial data.
The image uses the second GND on the power header (GND.2) for the potentiometer ground. The GND next to pin 13 (GND.3) is used for the LED cathode.
The potentiometer has its centre pin (SIG) on the upper half of the breadboard and its outer pins (GND, VCC) on the lower half, as drawn.
